name: Grand Hyatt Hong Kong
insider_take: Towering above Victoria Harbour with dramatic harbor and city skylines, this iconic waterfront sanctuary has been Hong Kong's most prestigious address since 1989.
whats_special: The Grand Hyatt Hong Kong features one of the world's most spectacular hotel lobbies with 30-foot ceilings and massive flower arrangements that change daily. The hotel's unique "art deco meets contemporary Asian" design includes original works by renowned artists, while its prime Wan Chai location connects directly to the Hong Kong Convention Centre.
pro_tip: Book a harbor view room on floors 20+ for unobstructed vistas of the Symphony of Lights show at 8pm nightly - you'll have front-row seats to the world's largest permanent light show right from your window.
dont_miss: The hotel's Plateau Spa features the city's only hotel pool with harbor views, while JJ's nightclub has been Hong Kong's legendary late-night hotspot for decades. Take the complimentary Rolls-Royce transfer to nearby attractions, and dine at Grissini for authentic Italian cuisine with panoramic harbor backdrop.
pros: Prime location in Wan Chai with direct access to Hong Kong Convention Centre
Stunning harbor views from premium rooms and suites
Exceptional dining options including Michelin-starred restaurants
World-class spa and fitness facilities with harbor panoramas
cons: Busy convention district location may not suit leisure-focused travelers
